decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence with low-cost creatures and then overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures and combat tricks. The deck also includes some utility cards like Thraben Inspector for card advantage and Giant Killer for removal options. The deck aims to close out games quickly by attacking aggressively and efficiently managing resources to outpace the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage provided by Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up its own win conditions with Shark Typhoon and The Wandering Emperor. The mana base is designed to support the control strategy with dual lands and utility lands such as Field of Ruin. The deck also includes a mix of board wipes, card draw spells, and versatile removal options to handle a variety of threats, ultimately grinding out the opponent with incremental advantages.

This deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with instants and sorceries to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard multiple times in a single turn. It utilizes cheap removal spells and card draw to quickly cycle through the deck, while also having disruptive spells like Spell Pierce to protect its key threats. The inclusion of Treasure Cruise and Pieces of the Puzzle allows for refilling the hand and finding key pieces to close out the game. The land base includes dual lands to ensure consistency in mana production for the deck's aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on the combo of Lotus Field and Sylvan Scrying to rapidly generate mana and enable powerful spells. It utilizes cards like Arboreal Grazer, Vizier of Tumbling Sands, and Hidden Strings to untap Lotus Field and generate additional mana. The deck also includes cards like Impulse and Pore Over the Pages to dig through the deck and find key combo pieces. The goal is to reach a critical mass of mana and then utilize cards like Emergent Ultimatum and Behold the Beyond to search for game-winning spells like Omniscience and cast them for free.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana with green devotion creatures and lands, allowing the player to cast powerful threats like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll early in the game. Cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional value and flexibility, while cards like Wolfwillow Haven and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx help to ensure a steady stream of mana. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with large creatures and efficient mana production, while also providing some control elements with cards like Teferi, Who Slows the Sunset and Boseiju, Who Endures.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by countering and removing threats from the opponent, while generating card advantage and eventually closing out the game with powerful finishers like Shark Typhoon. The deck includes a variety of removal spells, counterspells, card draw, and planeswalkers like Narset to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The mana base is designed to support the deck's spells and ensure consistent access to the necessary colors. The key strategy is to outvalue the opponent and maintain control of the game until victory is achieved.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of low-cost, aggressive white creatures. By playing multiple creatures each turn, buffing them with cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and using protection spells like Brave the Elements, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent and win the game quickly. The inclusion of cards like Ossification and Castle Ardenvale provide additional versatility and late-game power, ensuring that the deck remains a threat in the late game as well. Overall, the deck focuses on early aggression and efficient creature plays to achieve victory.

The key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of low-cost, efficient white creatures. By combining aggressive creatures like Hopeful Initiate, Thalia's Lieutenant, and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, with protection spells like Brave the Elements and Ossification, the deck aims to quickly build a threatening board presence. The inclusion of Thalia, Guardian of Thraben adds disruption to the opponent's game plan, while Kytheon, Hero of Akros provides a powerful late-game threat. The deck is supported by utility lands like Castle Ardenvale and Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire, as well as the versatile creature land Mutavault.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively ramp up mana with cards like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, while also focusing on green devotion with cards like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns. The deck utilizes powerful green creatures like Polukranos Reborn and Cityscape Leveler to apply pressure on the opponent. Storm the Festival allows for card advantage and potential board presence. Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional support and utility. Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx boosts mana production even further, leading to explosive plays and overwhelming the opponent.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay with a mix of powerful creatures and removal spells to apply pressure on the opponent. It utilizes a combination of efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester along with disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board and push for victory. The deck also includes some powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to close out games quickly. Additionally, the inclusion of versatile lands like Den of the Bugbear and Castle Locthwain allows for flexibility in playstyle and strategy.

This aggressive Rakdos deck focuses on efficiently disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while also applying pressure with powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. The deck also includes ways to recur threats from the graveyard with cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Graveyard Trespasser. The deck aims to maintain board presence and apply consistent pressure to quickly close out games against opponents in the Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on sacrificing creatures for value, utilizing cards like Mayhem Devil and Cauldron Familiar to ping the opponent and generate advantage. It also utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Witch's Oven to create a constant stream of threats. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds consistency to the deck. The deck aims to pressure the opponent with aggressive plays while disrupting their strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Claim the Firstborn. It also includes removal spells like Fatal Push to handle threats from the opponent.

The deck focuses on using sacrifice effects to generate value and damage opponents. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Bloodtithe Harvester with cards like Mayhem Devil and Witch's Oven, the deck can deal damage to opponents while disrupting their game plan. With cards like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn for removal and disruption, along with Thoughtseize for hand disruption, the deck aims to aggressively outpace opponents and control the battlefield. Additionally, cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional ways to generate value and advantage in the game.

The deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to trigger powerful effects like dealing damage to opponents or drawing cards. It utilizes cards like Mayhem Devil and Cauldron Familiar in combination with Witch's Oven to maintain board control and pressure the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides additional synergy and consistency to the deck. The deck also includes disruption elements like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly through aggressive sacrifice strategies.

This Weenie White Aggro deck focuses on flooding the board with low-cost, efficient creatures like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, supported by anthem effects from cards like Thalia's Lieutenant. Protection spells like Brave the Elements help to protect key creatures, while Ossification provides additional removal options. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures, utilizing the synergy between its efficient creatures and support spells to quickly close out the game.

This deck focuses on playing low-cost, aggressive creatures that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cards like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Thalia's Lieutenant to pump up its creatures and apply pressure. Protection spells like Brave the Elements and Ossification help keep your creatures alive while Castle Ardenvale provides additional creature tokens. The mana base includes Mutavault and Plains to ensure a smooth curve. The deck aims to go wide with a board full of small but powerful creatures to win the game quickly.

The deck focuses on generating a quick and aggressive board presence, utilizing cost-efficient creatures like Burning-Tree Emissary and Thraben Inspector to overwhelm the opponent. The cards such as Reckless Bushwhacker and Venerated Loxodon provide additional power boosts to push through damage quickly. With a low curve and efficient creatures, the deck aims to establish an early advantage and maintain pressure throughout the game. The inclusion of cards like Embercleave and Gleeful Demolition provides additional reach and removal options to help secure victories.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, as well as enchantments like Wolfwillow Haven to cast powerful green creatures and spells with high devotion to green mana. The deck focuses on aggressive plays with creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Polukranos Reborn, as well as utilizing green planeswalkers like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Karn, the Great Creator to gain advantage. The deck also includes toolbox cards like Storm the Festival and Boseiju, Who Endures to further enhance its gameplay.

The main concept of this deck is to use green devotion to ramp up mana quickly and play big threats to overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Old-Growth Troll, Cavalier of Thorns, and Polukranos Reborn provide powerful creatures, while cards like Storm the Festival and Wolfwillow Haven help ramp up mana. Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional value and utility. The deck focuses on creating a strong board presence and overwhelming the opponent with big creatures and efficient mana production.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana with green creatures like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, combined with cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx for massive amounts of mana. This allows you to play big threats like Polukranos Reborn and Cavalier of Thorns early on, supported by cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures and mana production, pushing for aggressive plays while maintaining devotion to green for added benefits.

The deck focuses on using Greasefang, Okiba Boss to generate tokens and sacrifice them for value, while also utilizing Parhelion II for additional token production and pressure. The deck runs a mix of disruption, card selection, and graveyard recursion to support the combo strategy. The inclusion of cards like Raffine's Informant and Scrapwork Mutt helps to further enhance the synergy of the deck. By combining these elements, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a steady stream of tokens and value generation, ultimately leading to a victory through overwhelming board presence and resource advantage.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive creature-based strategies, utilizing powerful combat tricks and efficient creatures to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By combining creatures with abilities to boost each other and deal direct damage, along with powerful equipment like Embercleave, the goal is to hit hard and fast to win the game before the opponent can assemble their own game plan. With a mix of resilient threats and ways to push through damage, this deck aims to be proactive and unrelenting in its assault.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with spells and then bring back Arclight Phoenix for recurring damage. Using cards like Ledger Shredder, Fiery Impulse, Lightning Axe, and Spikefield Hazard to fill the graveyard, while also drawing cards with Opt, Pieces of the Puzzle, and Treasure Cruise. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells and counter magic, while also being able to turbo out Arclight Phoenixes and potentially take extra turns with Temporal Trespass. Drawing cards and managing resources are key to ensure a steady stream of spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix.

This deck revolves around the combo of Jeskai Ascendancy and various cheap artifacts and creatures. The goal is to generate a large amount of mana and card draw by untapping and bouncing these artifacts and creatures with Jeskai Ascendancy's ability. The deck includes cards like Mishra's Research Desk, Mox Amber, Emry, Lurker of the Loch, and Retraction Helix to enable the combo. It also includes disruptive elements like Tormod's Crypt and Portable Hole to interact with the opponent's graveyard and creatures. The deck uses Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion for additional value.

This deck focuses on using spells and creature abilities to alter the board state and create powerful combos with Archfiend of the Dross and Bloodtithe Harvester. Thoughtseize and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker allow for control and manipulation of the opponent's hand and graveyard. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act to deal with threats. The land base is diverse to ensure the right colors are available for casting spells efficiently. Overall, the deck aims to set up game-winning combos while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on applying early pressure with aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester, while disrupting the opponent's plans with Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck also includes some powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to close out games. With a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and versatile threats like Graveyard Trespasser, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure victory before they can stabilize.

This Aggro Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on generating value by sacrificing creatures and dealing damage to opponents. Key cards include Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Bloodtithe Harvester for sacrificing and triggering abilities, along with Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for token generation. The deck also includes disruption with Thoughtseize and removal spells like Fatal Push. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as the companion, providing additional value and versatility. With a mix of sacrifice effects, removal, and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with constant pressure and incremental advantage.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of sacrificing creatures for value, dealing consistent damage with Mayhem Devil triggers, and disrupting the opponent's game plan with Thoughtseize and Claim the Firstborn. The deck seeks to control the board through sacrificing Cauldron Familiar and Bloodtithe Harvester while dealing damage with Mayhem Devil and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds another layer of consistency to the deck's game plan. With quick and aggressive plays, this deck aims to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to capitalize on the synergy between Spirits and Tempo in order to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By using disruptive Spirits such as Rattlechains and Spell Queller, combined with efficient creatures like Shacklegeist and Supreme Phantom, the deck aims to control the board and deal consistent damage. Curious Obsession provides card advantage while cards like Geistlight Snare and Lofty Denial help with disruption and protection. With a mix of aggressive and controlling elements, this Azorius Tempo / Spirit Aggro deck aims to outpace the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on using low-cost Spirit creatures to maintain board presence and pressure opponents while utilizing counterspells and removal to control the game. The deck's key strategy is to apply early pressure with evasive creatures like Shacklegeist and Spectral Sailor, while protecting them with cards like Rattlechains and Spell Queller. The inclusion of Curious Obsession and Slip Out the Back enables card advantage and evasion, while Lofty Denial offers a strong counterplay option. The deck aims to control the game tempo and win through a combination of evasive damage and countermagic.

This deck focuses on utilizing control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage and maintaining a strong board presence. With cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Shark Typhoon, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game and outvalue the opponent. By running counter spells like Dovin's Veto and removal spells like Fateful Absence and Supreme Verdict, the deck seeks to answer threats efficiently. Additionally, Kaheera, the Orphanguard provides an additional source of value and synergy with the deck's creature base. Land choices support the deck's strategy by providing flexibility and consistency.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a swarm of low-cost creatures while utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Thalia's Lieutenant to buff them up. The deck also includes protection spells like Brave the Elements to keep your creatures safe during combat. The mana base ensures consistent access to white mana for casting spells and activating abilities. The overall strategy is to apply early pressure and maintain board presence to swiftly defeat the opponent.
